title: Salesforce connector mTLS authentication is now generally available
body: Mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication for the Salesforce connector in Lakeflow Connect is now generally available. With mTLS, Databricks and Salesforce exchange and verify client certificates to establish two-way trust, combined with the OAuth client credentials flow. Choose it for API-only users or when your organization requires mTLS. See [Mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/salesforce-connection#mutual-tls-authentication).
